name: Davco Supamastic
paste:
DAVCO® SUPAMASTIC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco® Supamastic, March 2025, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/davco-supamastic.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco® Supamastic where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. A ready to use premixed thin bed wall tile adhesives for internal use.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Davco® Supamastic can be used for residential internal thin bed wall applications with porous tiles (>3% absorption) on porous substrates.
    - Davco® Supamastic can be used for residential internal dry area floor tiling application with porous backed tiles (>3% absorption) on porous substrates - primed Cement Sheet/Ceramic Tile Underlay.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Please note.
    - If you are uncertain of the porosity of the tiles you are fixing use Davco SMP Evo adhesive or seek technical advice from Sika Australia.
    - Refer the the Davco SMP Evo product data sheet for additional information.
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Suitable substrates include.
    - Fibre cement sheet
    - Plasterboard
    - Ceramic tile underlay
    - Rendered blockwork & brickwork
    - Davco K10 Plus waterproof membrane (drying times will be greatly extended over waterproof membrane, therefore only of fixing of porous backed tiles ≥3%)
1.6 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Suitable Tile Types include.
    - Ceramic
    - Mosaic
    - Natural stone not sensitive to moisture
    Not suitable for use with porcelain tiles greater than 200x200 size. For these applications use Davco SMP Evo adhesive.
1.7 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco® Supamastic
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (March 2025, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product Declaration (p.1).
    - AS3958:2023: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Application Instructions > Laying the Tiles (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Zero waste and fast clean up
    - White formulation ideal for light coloured tiles
    - Non slump
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: White paste.
    - Product Declaration: D1TE AS ISO 13007 Classification.
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 4Ltr & 15Ltr pails
    - Shelf life: 12 Months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunshine.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer's instructions and relevant standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean, and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose material or bond inhibitor. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling.
    - Deeply contaminated surfaces must be mechanically prepared to a clean sound substrate. Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces.
    - Substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards L/360 for tiles or L/720 for natural stone
    - Surfaces shall be primed as per the below
    | Substrate | Prime with |
    | Rendered block or brickwork | Davco Ultraprime or Davco Primex |
    | Fibre Cement Sheet | Davco Ultraprime or Dav- |
    | . | co Primex |
    | Plasterboard | Davco Ultraprime or Davco Primex |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (March 2025, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: A 4 Litre pail will cover approximately 3m² with a 6mm notch trowel. A 15 Pail will cover approximately 11m² with a 6mm notch trowel.
    - Layer Thickness: Layer thickness shall be no greater than 4mm.
    - Open Time: 30 Minutes.
    - Adjustability Time: 45 Minutes.
4.3 Applied Product Ready for Use.
    - All measurements are taken at 22°C & 50% relative humidity. Specifications vary according to site conditions and should be taken as a guide only.
    - Cool or cold weather will extend drying times of premixed adhesives.
    - Non porous tiles will greatly extend drying time of adhesive.
    - Drying time over membranes will be greatly extended.
    | Set time before grouting* | 24 hours |
    | Set time before dry area service* | 48 hours |
    | Set time before wet area service* | 7 days |
4.4 Equipment. Select a trowel with a suitable notch size for the tile size and type as per the following:
    | Tile Size | Trowel notch size | Back buttering required |
    | Mosaics | 4-6mm | No |
    | 150x150 | 6mm | No |
    | 200x200 | 8mm | No |
    | 300x300 | 10mm | No |
    | 400x400* | 12mm | Yes |
    | 600x300* *Tiles larges than 200x200 size must have a porous base (greater than 3%). | 12mm | Yes |
4.5 Application - Laying the Tiles. 1. Place the adhesive onto the prepared and primed substrate. Do not apply more adhesive than can be tiles within the open time of the product, usually from a single tile to 1m². 2. Hold the notched trowel at an angle of 60° or greater to the substrate. 3. Spread the adhesive over the required area where tile is to be applied, comb the adhesive in a single direction (not swirls). 4. Where "back buttering" the tile is required, use the flat side of the notched trowel to apply a thin adhesive layer to the back of the tile (approx 1-2mm thick). 5. Place the tile into the combed adhesive and press the tile firmly. 6. Move the tile forward and then back at 90° across the direction of the combed adhesive to flatten the adhesive to leave no voids under the tile. Occasionally life a tile to check the adhesive covers 90-100% of the tile. 7. Remove any excess adhesive in the joints, and on the face of the tile with a sponge and water while the adhesive is still wet.
    - Do not allow the adhesive to skin prior to placement of the tiles. If the adhesive skins, remove and replace.
    - Application shall be in accordance with AS3958:2023 The Installation of Ceramic and Stone Tiles.
    - Movement joints shall be installed in accordance with applicable standards.
    - Back buttering the tiles may be required to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
    - Allow the adhesive to dry prior to grouting.
4.6 Cleaning of tools. Clean tools and equipment with water prior to adhesive drying.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first.
    - Not suitable for use over concrete substrates, use a suitable Davco cement based adhesive.
    - Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone.
    - Davco® Supamastic is suitable for adhering porous (>3% absorption) tiles over Davco Waterproof membranes (k10 Plus, Dampfast, K10 Rapid, & K12) for wall only. However the drying time will be greatly extended, and extra drying time shall be required prior to grouting
    - For uses not mentions in this document please seek further technical advice from Sika Australia.
4.8 Environmental information. Low VOC Specification for V2 IEQ-13, V1.1 IEQ-11

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient Air Temperature. Min +5°C to Max 35°C
5.3 Substrate Temperature. Min +5°C to Max 35°C
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone.
5.5 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first.
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco® Supamastic, March 2025, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/davco-supamastic.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Supamastic, version 28/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/a/sds-davco-supamastic.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological, and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
